# Coding Repository Fixtures

These synthetic repositories exercise the Coding Repository profile and composable codebase-map capability. They contain no real secrets, client data, or private material.

- `small-service/` — code-primary root map kept in `AGENTS.md`.
- `monorepo-distributed/` — code-primary `CONTEXT-MAP.md` plus selected app/package contexts.
- `hybrid-release-code/` — Stage Pipeline primary profile with overlapping codebase mapping.
- `existing-doc-duplication/` — pre-adoption conflicting documentation for Curated proposal and optimization detection/decline QA.
- `optimization-writing-lens/` — approved-write `/picm-optimize` fixture for source snapshots, routed task guidance, five writing-lens outcomes, canonical pointers, generated-doc boundaries, and preserved local safety and approval guidance.
- `ignored-secrets-existing/` — pre-adoption Git-ignore boundary fixture; create only clearly synthetic ignored files in a disposable copy as documented in `docs/layout-fixture-qa.md`.

The three adopted fixtures model new Strict-first adoption and therefore store `capabilities.codebaseMap.maintenancePreset: "strict"` as legacy metadata. Focused preservation and dispatch tests separately cover historical explicit `light`, `balanced`, and `strict` values plus an absent value: none selects a run depth, an absent value has no Balanced fallback, and Light has no active or scheduled compatibility dispatch.

Fixtures are recommendations and test surfaces, not canonical repository schemas. Interactive `/picm-*` QA must use disposable Git copies and must not write without an exact preview and explicit approval.
